svg.aria-label: A quiet moonscape at night: a small robot with a telescope watches a constellation shaped like a rising chart draw itself across the sky with a star for each of Rust, Python, Go, TypeScript, SQL, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, Docker, Kafka, Redpanda, Ansible, Kubernetes, Proxmox and Solidity, a purple flag stands planted in the surface, and the caption reads star chart, not price chart. After 20 seconds, little green aliens rise out of the moon, gather under the robot, crowd surf it off the left edge and throw it to the ringed planet
